Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Triangular Wall Mount Planter, 7"H, Modern Earthenware, Grey
Colors: Grey
Materials: earthenware
This triangular vase makes a wonderful decorative piece for your wall. It's glazed for a concrete-like appearance, adding a bit of an industrial touch. The neutral tone looks great with or without plants, by itself or in a group of vases. Modern shape with neutral coloring to blend with any style room. 100% earthenware 5.5"W X 2.1"D X 7"H; interior 4.725"W x 1.77"D x 6.1"H Durable piece with hole on back for easy mounting on wall
